messages.content: Follow the production contract exactly. Return valid JSON only.

AUTHORITATIVE SOURCE UNITS:
1. A team completes field work at a remote site.
2. Three months later the team begins analysis in a city lab.
3. Most of this phase is repeated laboratory analysis.
4. A final test resolves the question and the team prepares the report.
5. One year later the team returns to the remote site.

A chapter is a LARGE H3 refresh unit.
Use the FEWEST chapter boundaries that preserve major narrative phases.
Major time/location/state resets require new chapters.
Terminal resolution plus immediate closure may remain in one chapter.

Return JSON with key new_chapter_after, an array of source-unit numbers.
